description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Capgemini is hiring a Java Full Stack Developer to support enterprise application modernization and technical debt remediation. The role develops Java and Angular applications, maintains APIs and integration services, assists with middleware migration and deployments, and contributes to application quality and Agile delivery.
Java Full-Stack Developer supporting enterprise modernization with Spring Boot, Angular, REST APIs, and legacy middleware migration

Responsibilities:
• Support application modernization and technical debt remediation initiatives across enterprise platforms and services
• Develop Java and Spring Boot applications while supporting migration from legacy middleware technologies
• Build and enhance Angular-based web applications using TypeScript, HTML5, CSS, and modern UI frameworks
• Assist with WebSphere migration, Tomcat deployment, and environment configuration efforts
• Develop and maintain REST APIs and integration services supporting enterprise business processes
• Work closely with senior engineers on application remediation, code optimization, and performance improvement efforts
• Support build automation, deployment validation, and production stabilization activities
• Participate in Agile planning, estimation, sprint execution, and retrospective activities
• Identify and resolve application defects and technical issues in development and production environments
• Maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives across the team

Pay: $70K/yr - $85K/yr
